dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier national ile de france

description: Réseau routier national Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France. Ce jeu de données contient l'ensemble des axes de voies. Ces voies principales (autoroutes, voies rapides, routes nationales et départementales, voies secondaires importantes) sont renseignées par le nom et le statut. Réseau routier national approuvé en conseil régional dans le cadre du Plan Route ( Rapport CR 2017-54 ). Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Routes, Autoroutes, Transport, IDG, geoidf. The portal shows 6,894 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
